About National Global Academy, Noida.

ABOUT US

Shaping global careers with structured training and family first guidance.

National Global Academy is a Global Career Training Institute in Noida, with 10+ years of guidance experience. We support students exploring cruise, Merchant Navy, aviation and hospitality pathways through route first counselling and monthly batches, with parents included at every step.

Selected courses include 100% Placement Support as listed in their course information.
